summary: Decipher feature (court order upload + Gemini 2.5 Pro analysis) fully verified end-to-end. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass including real Gemini call, mime validation (400 on application/zip), GET /api/orders/{id} retrieval, stats incrementing orders_analyzed, and smoke for all prior endpoints. Frontend /decipher page renders dropzone, accepts file via hidden input, triggers loading state, then displays full structured result with all expected sections.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analyze_order: tempfile path is cleaned up in finally — good. mime allow-list is explicit. _safe_parse_json gracefully handles non-JSON Gemini responses.
server.py uses gemini-2.5-pro with FileContentWithMimeType as expected — only viable path for file attachments via emergentintegrations.
Mongo insert mutates dict with _id; code correctly pops it before returning the response.
OrderAnalysisResult.analysis is typed as dict (free-form). Acceptable given Gemini may occasionally drift; _safe_parse_json keeps response shape stable.
server.py is now ~650 lines and could be split (routes/models/seed) but is still readable; flag only if it grows further.
No file-size guard until after read() completes — for very large uploads this loads entire body in memory. 15MB cap is enforced post-read; acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new decipher tests + smoke for prior endpoints)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of /decipher flow + Home promo + Navbar link verified

test_credentials: None required. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env powers both Anthropic (chat) and Gemini (decipher).
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 order analysis record in db.order_analyses (sample_order_ui.txt also persisted via UI flow), 1 TEST_ contact, 1 TEST_ booking. No destructive changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Decipher endpoint POST /api/orders/analyze takes multipart 'file' (UploadFile) and optional 'notes' (Form). Allowed mimes: application/pdf, text/plain, image/png|jpeg|webp|heic|heif. Real Gemini 2.5 Pro call typically takes 10-30s for a small text file. Frontend testids on /decipher: decipher-dropzone, decipher-choose-file, decipher-file-input, decipher-file-name, decipher-remove-file, decipher-notes, decipher-submit-btn, decipher-loading, decipher-placeholder, decipher-result, decipher-obligation-N, decipher-deadline-N, decipher-next-step-N, decipher-watch-N, decipher-question-N, decipher-disclaimer, decipher-emotional. Home: decipher-promo-section + home-decipher-cta. Navbar: nav-link-decipher-order. /api/stats now exposes orders_analyzed count.
